review.instruction: Check every requested language and artifact against the frozen brief. Every learning outcome, source constraint and requested track must be covered without adding a new curriculum claim.
Review factual support, attribution, learner clarity, examples, accessibility and internal consistency. Identify concrete unsupported or misleading statements.

Inspect each executable track using its unchanged build and check transcript. When images are present, inspect actual pixels against the brief and the supplied baseline; reject unrelated art or unverified visual inheritance.
Require a review based on the artifacts without the producer's rationale. Every applicable finding must be resolved and reassessed before acceptance.

failurePolicy: Freeze the brief before production. For each failed criterion, retain concise feedback, repair only the owning edition, track, image or record, then reassess. Discard rejected image files while retaining failure metadata and accepted outputs.
